description: This file defines the JiraService class, which provides methods to interact with Jira's REST API, including authentication, fetching user projects, and retrieving project details.

classes.name: JiraService
classes.description: Service class for interacting with Jira REST API, encapsulating methods for user authentication, project retrieval, and project detail fetching.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] authenticate_user(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str)
methods.description: Authenticates a user with Jira using provided email, API token, and domain, returning user info and success status.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] fetch_user_projects(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str)
methods.description: Fetches all projects accessible to the authenticated user, returning a list of project summaries.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_project_details(self, email: str, api_token: str, domain: str, project_key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Jira project given its project key.
